pages.title: Allergy testing and treatment in Muscat
worst: James examines your nose, throat, skin and chest, and looks for patterns like seasonal flares, home versus work differences, and links to foods or medicines.
Testing is suggested only when it changes management: allergy blood tests or a referral for skin testing when the trigger stays unclear, and an action plan if you have had severe reactions.
If a severe allergy is suspected, an emergency action plan is written out clearly for you and your family.

pages.title: Anaemia and low iron checks in Muscat
worst: James asks about diet, periods, gut symptoms, previous blood counts and family blood conditions, then examines for pallor and other clues.
Your blood count is reviewed properly: not just haemoglobin but cell size and pattern, which point toward the cause.
Further tests are chosen by the pattern: ferritin for iron stores, B12 and folate, thyroid function, or screening for thalassemia trait.

pages.title: Asthma and breathing problems in Muscat
worst: James asks about the pattern: when symptoms started, what triggers them, night symptoms, smoke and dust exposure, and your medicines.
He listens to your chest and may arrange spirometry (a breathing test) or a chest X-ray when needed.
The goal is a clear label for the problem: asthma, allergy-driven cough, post-viral cough, reflux-related cough or something else.

pages.title: Care for older adults in Muscat
worst: James reviews the full picture: each condition, each medicine and why it was started, recent reports, falls, appetite, sleep, mood and memory concerns.
Examination covers pressure lying and standing (a drop on standing causes falls), heart, chest and basic function.
Medicines are reviewed together rather than one by one: what still earns its place, what interacts, what can be simplified.

pages.title: Chest infections and pneumonia in Muscat
worst: James asks how the illness started and progressed, then checks your temperature, oxygen level, breathing rate and listens to your chest.
A chest X-ray is arranged when pneumonia or another cause needs ruling out.
You get an honest answer about whether the illness is viral and just needs support, or bacterial and needs antibiotics, plus clear instructions on what should improve and when.

pages.title: Diabetes and prediabetes care in Muscat
worst: James listens first: how long the problem has been there, your family history, your routine and the medicines you already take.
He examines you, checks your feet, weight and blood pressure, and reviews your old reports.
He may ask for a fasting sugar, HbA1c (a three-month average of your blood sugar), kidney function, cholesterol and a urine test for protein.

pages.title: Digestive problems and gut health in Muscat
worst: James takes the history that usually makes the diagnosis: which symptoms, their timing, relation to meals, stress, travel, medicines like painkillers, and any alarm features.
He examines your abdomen and checks for anaemia clues like pallor.
Tests are chosen for a reason: blood tests for anaemia or inflammation, stool tests for infection or hidden blood, an H.

pages.title: Fatty liver disease in Muscat
worst: James asks about alcohol honestly, medicines and supplements, weight history, and your diabetes and cholesterol picture.
He examines your abdomen and reviews your liver tests and any ultrasound report.
The job at this visit is twofold: confirm that fat is the likely explanation and rule out other causes like viral hepatitis, and estimate how much the liver is affected.

pages.title: Fever and infections in Muscat
worst: You leave knowing the most likely cause, whether an antibiotic is genuinely indicated, and exactly which warning signs mean come back now.
James maps the timeline: when the fever started, its pattern, what came with it, travel, contacts, and medicines already taken.
A full examination follows: throat, ears, chest, abdomen, skin and urine check as appropriate.

pages.title: Heart risk assessment in Muscat
worst: James takes a full history: family heart events, smoking, diet, activity, stress and any symptoms like chest tightness, breathlessness or palpitations.
He measures your blood pressure, weight and waist, listens to your heart, and reviews or orders the relevant blood tests and an ECG if indicated.
Your results are then combined into a plain answer: low, medium or high risk, and which factors are doing most of the damage.

pages.title: High blood pressure care in Muscat
worst: James asks about salt, sleep, stress, alcohol, medicines and family history, then measures your pressure properly in both arms after rest.
He examines your heart and checks for signs that pressure has already affected the eyes, heart or kidneys.
He may ask for home readings over a week, basic kidney and sugar tests, and an ECG (a heart tracing).

pages.title: High cholesterol checks and treatment in Muscat
worst: James goes through your lipid profile (the fat breakdown in your blood test) and asks about diet, activity, smoking, alcohol and family history.
He checks your blood pressure, weight and waist, because these change what your cholesterol numbers mean for you.
Two people with the same cholesterol can need very different treatment.

pages.title: Joint pain and arthritis care in Muscat
worst: James maps the pain: which joints, what time of day, what triggers and relieves it, stiffness, swelling, and how it started.
He examines the joints for warmth, swelling and range, and checks muscle strength and gait.
Blood tests for inflammation, uric acid, vitamin D and related markers are added when the pattern suggests them, and imaging only when it will change management.

pages.title: Kidney problems and checks in Muscat
worst: James asks about urine changes, swelling, infections, stones, medicines and your diabetes and pressure control.
Kidney function is assessed with creatinine and eGFR blood tests and a urine test for protein, sometimes an ultrasound of the kidneys.
He then explains where your kidney health stands: normal, early change, or needs a kidney specialist, and which medicines need dose care.

pages.title: Preventive health check-ups in Muscat
worst: James asks about your history, family history, diet, activity, sleep, smoking and alcohol, then examines you: pressure, weight, waist, heart and chest.
James after a consultation, based on your conditions and symptoms, so no test is repeated or wasted.
When results return, you sit down again and go through them in plain language: what is normal, what needs watching, and what needs action.

pages.title: Sleep apnea and sleep problems in Muscat
worst: James asks about your sleep pattern, what your partner has noticed, caffeine, alcohol, shift work, and your medicines.
He examines your weight, neck, nose and throat, checks your blood pressure, and screens for related problems like thyroid disease.
When apnea is suspected, a sleep study is arranged to measure breathing, oxygen and sleep stages.

pages.title: Thyroid problems checked and treated in Muscat
worst: James asks about your symptoms, medicines, supplements and family history, then examines your neck, pulse, skin and reflexes.
He reviews your thyroid function tests (the blood tests TSH, T4 and T3) and may repeat them or add an antibody test to find the cause.
If a lump or nodule is suspected, an ultrasound may be arranged.

pages.title: Medical weight management in Muscat
worst: James takes a careful history: when the weight changed, your eating pattern, sleep, activity, stress, medicines and previous attempts.
He measures weight, waist and blood pressure, and may check your thyroid, sugar and liver tests, because weight is often a symptom as much as a cause.
You then agree a realistic target and the first changes to make.
